title: Cultural Resources Commission short on members
summary: The county's boards and commissions liaison now believes no one is on the applicant list for this commission. The July 2 meeting ended for lack of a quorum before the director's report. The vice chair said back in February 2025 that the commission had missed quorum for many meetings while a whole historic district hopes to be rebuilt.
